name: Fonbet
note: Russian bookmaker; licence held by OOO 'Fonkor', whose register founder is AO 'Klir Tsentr' (Stavka.TV, September 2026) - Klir Tsentr's owner is not identified. In April 2022 Fonbet's site named Pin-Up.ru (then newly bought by Alexander Udodov) as its owner (The Bell); whether that still holds is unconfirmed.
